name: Homemade Orange Juice
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: With a knife, remove the peel and skin from the oranges. Using a tiny knife, slice the orange in half and remove all of the seeds. Place it in the blender after further cutting it into smaller pieces.
To the blender, add 1 tbsp of sugar and either ice or water. Pulse several times very smooth.
Strain the mixture. Once ready, pour the filtrated orange juice into a glass cup.
